text: PBOC will conduct overnight reverse repos on Aug. 14 and Aug. 17–19 to better meet short-term banking-system liquidity needs; operations will be fixed-rate, quantity-based tenders with daily allotments capped at 600 billion yuan.
text_zh: 中国央行将于8月14日及8月17–19日开展隔夜逆回购操作，以更好满足银行体系短期流动性需求；操作将采用固定利率、数量招标，每日投放上限为6000亿元。
